Strong background in learning evaluation, measurement, and analytics. Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of development initiatives. Experience supporting culturally diverse and geographically dispersed teams. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Adult Learning, Instructional Design, Organizational Psychology, Education, or a related field preferred. Fluent English speaker with exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Experience building leadership development, coaching, and mentorship programs. Experience creating competency frameworks and career architecture models. Partner with HR and business leaders to strengthen succession readiness and internal talent mobility. Learning Measurement & Analytics Conduct learning needs assessments and capability analyses. Measure learning effectiveness through multi-level evaluation methodologies. Track and report on key metrics such as: Learning participation Competency attainment Time-to-competency Internal mobility Leadership readiness Learning application and impact Use data and insights to improve learning programs and investments continuously. Facilitation & Program Delivery Facilitate leadership, management, professional development, and culture-building programs globally. Special Projects Lead and support strategic People & Culture initiatives related to organizational effectiveness, talent development, and employee growth. Reporting to the Head of Communications, you’ll keep content and event projects moving at once, contributing creative ideas to the association’s social media, shaping how we spotlight members and showcase our events, and carrying projects from first idea to execution. You’ll have a visible hand in signature programs like the Coolest Thing Made in California, CMTA’s annual contest celebrating products manufactured in California, and you’ll work closely with our Government Relations and Membership teams, association leadership, and members. CMTA is a growing nonprofit organization with opportunities for career advancement. We are broadening our advocacy channels for manufacturers and expanding what we deliver to our members. You’d be joining at a moment when you’ll have a hands-on role with ownership, creative freedom, and influence over how CMTA shows up in front of members, the media, and policymakers. Schedule: Full-time, exempt Compensation: $75,000–$90,000 annually Type: On-site in Downtown Sacramento, with some hybrid Fridays Reports to: Head of Communications ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Communications & Content – 70% Social media content creation and management Own CMTA’s social media presence end to end Develop a strategic content calendar in coordination with the Head of Communications Create platform-specific content (graphics, copy, and video) for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, and other channels Showcase CMTA events through live coverage, photography, and phone videography Monitor social media engagement and report monthly analytics Newsletter development Own the writing and formatting of California Manufacturing Monthly , CMTA’s monthly newsletter, in a consistent editorial voice and structure Support development of other CMTA newsletters and email campaigns Written communications Write blog posts, website copy, announcements, and other communications Turn policy, manufacturing, and business developments into clear, accessible content in coordination with the Head of Communications and the Government Relations Team Repurpose content across channels to extend reach Member storytelling Identify and develop stories about CMTA members and their work Turn member news and milestones into compelling content across CMTA channels Website Share responsibility with the Head of Communications for keeping the CMTA website current and on brand Events – 20% Event communications and execution Develop materials and communications for CMTA events (promotional graphics, signage, programs, and agendas) Support on-site communications and event execution for conferences, meetings, receptions, tours, fundraisers, and other CMTA programs Provide on-site photography and phone videography Create post-event recaps and follow-up communications as needed Coolest Thing Made in California Play a central role in CMTA’s annual contest, helping drive campaign planning, social media presence, promotion, outreach, and awards ceremony materials Media & Public Relations – 5% PR and media support Share responsibility for press releases and media advisories with the Head of Communications Other Duties & Responsibilities as Assigned – 5% Provide general support for association initiatives, communications, and events as needed REQUIREMENTS 2–4 years in nonprofit communications, marketing, public relations, or a related field Experience with social media strategy and content creation Experience with newsletter messaging Photography skills (comfortable with, or willing to learn, CMTA’s Canon Mark IV camera) Experience with video editing Experience with Canva PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with policy and legislative messaging Experience with Mailchimp or similar email marketing platforms Experience with WordPress websites Event coordination experience, or a strong interest in event support COMPENSATION Full-time, exempt (salaried) position $75,000–$90,000 annually This range reflects what CMTA reasonably expects to pay for this role. Placement within range depends on experience and qualifications. BENEFITS Paid time off, holidays, and sick time Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage with CMTA contributing up to $800 toward monthly premiums 401(k) match Monthly phone stipend Paid monthly parking in a covered garage located half a block from the office Summer Fridays HOW TO APPLY Submit your name, email, resume, and cover letter here: cmta.net/jobs-communications-manager. We review applications on a rolling basis. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT The California Manufacturers & Technology Association is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities — contact us if you need an accommodation during the application process.

review_candidates.title: Civil Engineer - Land Development
review_candidates.description: Are you ready to grow your career while making a lasting impact on the built environment? Join a collaborative team where you'll work alongside experienced engineers and project managers to deliver innovative land development projects throughout the Nashville area. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys problem-solving, values mentorship, and wants to expand their technical and professional skills. Position Overview We are seeking a Civil Design Engineer with experience in land development to support a variety of residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects. In this role, you'll contribute to projects from the early planning stages through final design, working closely with clients, regulatory agencies, and internal team members to develop practical and efficient engineering solutions. Key Responsibilities Prepare site development plans, including grading, drainage, utility, and stormwater management designs. Assist with feasibility studies, due diligence research, and technical reports. Develop engineering calculations and construction drawings using AutoCAD Civil 3D. Coordinate with project managers, engineers, clients, and permitting agencies to keep projects moving forward. Support local and state permitting efforts and regulatory approvals. Participate in project meetings and contribute creative solutions to engineering challenges. Maintain quality, accuracy, and attention to detail throughout the design process. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum of 2+ years of experience in civil site design or land development. Working knowledge of AutoCAD Civil 3D. Experience with residential, commercial, or industrial development projects. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment. What You'll Find Here We believe professional growth happens through hands-on experience, collaboration, and continuous learning. You'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects while receiving mentorship from experienced professionals who are invested in your success. As your skills grow, you'll have opportunities to take on additional responsibility and advance your career. Compensation & Benefits We offer a competitive salary along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) with company matching Paid vacation and company holidays Performance-based bonus opportunities Annual salary reviews Paid parental leave Life insurance Employee wellness programs Professional development and training opportunities Team-building events and a collaborative work environment Equal Opportunity Employer We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where individuals from all backgrounds are valued and respected. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any legally protected status. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Employment sponsorship may not be available for this position. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, age, color, sex (including pregnancy), religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, military status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable laws or regulations. GPAC (Growing People and Companies) is an award-winning search firm specializing in placing quality professionals within multiple industries across the United States since 1990. We are extremely competitive, client-focused and realize that our value is in our ability to deliver the right solutions at the right time.
